title: RF_DETECTION
description: Signal detection event published by sdr_acquisition to the rf.detections AMQP topic whenever a signal clears the CA-CFAR threshold, the PAPR filter, and the persistence filter.

schema_version.description: Message schema version. Consumers should ignore unknown fields from higher versions.

timestamp_ms.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds (system_clock, UTC) at the moment the detection was confirmed.

scanner_id.description: Identifier of the scanner instance that produced this detection (matches <scanner_id> in scanner.xml).

center_freq_hz.description: Sub-bin parabolic-interpolated centre frequency of the detected signal in Hz. Accuracy: ±1–2 kHz at 20 MSPS / 4096-point FFT.

bandwidth_hz.description: Estimated occupied bandwidth in Hz, measured as the distance between the first and last bins of the detection run.

power_db.description: Peak power of the detection run in dBFS (decibels relative to full-scale). Negative values only.

channel.description: Zero-based RX channel index on the hardware device.

iq_snapshot.description: Interleaved float32 IQ samples from the detecting dwell: [I₀, Q₀, I₁, Q₁, …]. Always 2048 values (1 024 complex samples) when present. The sample rate is given by snapshot_sample_rate_sps. Introduced in schema_version 1.1. Used by AnalysisApp for zero-acquisition ONNX fast-path classification.

snapshot_sample_rate_sps.description: Sample rate of the iq_snapshot in samples per second (typically the scan sample rate, e.g. 20 000 000). Present whenever iq_snapshot is present. Introduced in schema_version 1.1.

$comment: Version history: 1.0 — initial release. 1.1 — added iq_snapshot + snapshot_sample_rate_sps (optional, for ONNX fast-path in AnalysisApp).
